title: Not a quality candle, and not worth buying
text: Not a quality candle, and not worth buying. The only reason these last 8 hours (actual performance seems to be about 6-7) is because they are twice as large as regular tea lights. And due to the metal casing each sits in (unless it falls out of the casing, which many of them do), once the candle burns for a few hours, the flame is lost below the rim of the metal casing and thus provides very little light. I was hoping these would be a higher-quality, denser wax that would burn longer (the picture does not show a double-height candle), but this is not the case, Also, the wax is very soft and marked/chipped on lots of the candles, which makes these look/feel cheap right out of the box. Some of the wicks pull right out of the candle as well. This is not a quality product. Cheap junk that left me feeling disappointed and like I had wasted my money. Will not buy again, and cannot recommend.
